# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $200

I can't browse, so I only have the search results. Only the Soundcore Space One Pro had a direct buy link. For the others, I've linked the review pages, which list current retailer prices.

## Top picks

**Best ANC overall: JBL Live 780NC**
- RTINGS says its ANC competes with flagship Sony and Bose models, and it lasts 60 hours.
- It supports multipoint, LDAC, and wired use.
- The downsides are high clamping force and thin headband padding, so it may be uncomfortable for larger heads.
- RTINGS says it sometimes goes on sale just under $200. Check the current price before you buy.
- [RTINGS review with retailer prices](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

**Best value: Anker Soundcore Space Q45**
- It costs around $100, and RTINGS calls it the best headphones under $200 overall.
- It has very good noise isolation and about 28 hours of battery.
- The downsides are a slight hiss with ANC on and user reports of hinge and headband breakage.
- [RTINGS review](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/by-price/under-200)

**Best sound: Sennheiser Accentum Plus**
- It has a smooth, warm sound, a parametric EQ, and 56 hours of battery.
- Its ANC is weaker than the others, especially against low rumble like plane engines.
- It uses aptX Adaptive, which Apple devices don't support natively.
- [RTINGS review](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

**Best for calls and an all-rounder: Sony ULT WEAR**
- SoundGuys measured more than 25 dB of attenuation above 80 Hz, which was the strongest low-frequency result in its group.
- It has LDAC, multipoint, and about 32 hours of battery.
- It was listed at $200 in March, so it may be cheaper or pricier now.
- [RatingMobile summary](https://ratingmobile.com/articles/en/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

**Best long-haul battery: Soundcore Space One Pro**
- It lasts 40 hours with ANC on and has LDAC and a fold-flat design.
- The list price is $199.99. Dealectric reports that code AFSC20 took $39.99 off in Soundcore's cart on 2026-10-22, which brings it to about $160. The code expires 2026-12-31 and isn't valid on items already on sale. The store's checkout has the final word.
- [Buy at Soundcore via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one-pro). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you.
- Tom's Guide also lists it as its best under $200 ([Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/us/best-noise-cancelling-headphones%2Creview-5566.html)).
- Dealectric notes the newer Space 2 Pro costs the same but lasts only 30 hours with ANC on.

## Cheaper options
- **JLab JBuds Lux ANC (about $80):** 44-hour battery, but the weakest ANC of the SoundGuys picks. It's fine for buses and offices, less so for planes. [RatingMobile](https://ratingmobile.com/articles/en/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)
- **Anker Soundcore Life Q20 2024:** Near-Q45 noise isolation and 49 hours of battery, but the build is plastic and the earpads can flake. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)
- **Sony WH-CH730N (about $176–179):** Tom's Guide praises its sound, ANC, and comfort but thinks the US price is high. [Tom's Guide review](https://www.tomsguide.com/audio/headphones/sony-wh-ch730n-review)

## Quick advice
- **Strongest ANC:** JBL Live 780NC.
- **Best on a budget:** Soundcore Space Q45.
- **Sound quality first:** Sennheiser Accentum Plus.
- **Longest trips:** Soundcore Space One Pro with the code.

Prices move often, so confirm them at checkout.
